remarks: Completely Renovated! Be the First to Call this Spacious 1,400 sq. ft. Townhouse Home! Located in a prime Mid-City Stamford location, enjoy the conveniently close to downtown with all its  amenities - parks & beaches, shopping, cultural events, major transportation; this beautifully upgraded residence offers modern day luxury and convenience. Gorgeous White kitchen  featuring quartz countertops, top of the line stainless steel appliances, stylish tile backsplash & deep undermount sink. There are 3 fully renovated bathrooms, bright living room showcasing a cozy fireplace with a sleek granite hearth and surround, while the dining area opens to a private balcony.  The primary bedroom suite boasts a brand-new full bath, large walk-in closet and abundant natural light. The spacious second bedroom is equally inviting with large double door closet.  You'll love the convenience of the new washer/dryer located upstairs in its own closet & enjoy peace of mind with new window & sliding door glass thru-out, a brand-new HVAC system, hot  water heater & newly installed "Select Oak" hardwood flooring thru-out. New interior doors & hardware along with updated electrical - recessed LED lighting, switches & wall plates complete this beautiful transformation. There is some storage in the common area basement. With off-street and on-street parking, this townhouse has everything you need to move right in and enjoy modern living. Don't miss out on this stunning home.
